newsitem.title: USA: Most IMM currencies close down, but off day's lows.
newsitem.headline: Most IMM currencies close down, but off day's lows.

text.p: Jan 28 - Most IMM currency futures closed lower but up from the days lows, underpinned by profit-taking in afternoon trade. IMM marks, Swiss and yen all hit contract lows overnight, yen made new lows during the day. Traders said tone still weak despite the profittaking. Canadian dollar posted mild gains as bullish momentum there returns, trader said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
